summary_en: 5,003,341 shares cancelled on 2026-08-06 (8.04% of shares outstanding before cancellation). Post-cancellation issued shares excluding treasury: 56,213,059. Remaining treasury shares: 1,000,000.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: Marvelous Inc. completed the cancellation of 5,003,341 treasury shares on 2 August 6, 2026, pursuant to a board resolution dated July 31, 2026 and in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 8.04% of issued shares before cancellation. Following completion, the company has 56,213,059 issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury) and retains 1,000,000 shares in treasury.
